description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next.  Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.
 
 
To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen. This position requires an active U.S. Government security clearance, applicants who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be eligible for consideration. Employment for cleared roles is contingent upon verification of clearance status.

 Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).
 
 Please review the job details below. 
 
 This position requires an active U.S. Government Security Clearance at the TS/SCI level.

 Unlock the future with Vantor! Join a platform team supporting multi-site Red Hat OpenShift clusters and NetApp-backed storage services. You will help operate and improve platform reliability, lifecycle management, automation, security, and recovery capabilities while partnering with storage, network, security, and development teams. The role supports mission-critical workloads in a secure or disconnected environment.

 Responsibilities :
 Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters across on-premise and hybrid cloud environments
 Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support containerized application delivery 
 Implement infrastructure as code
 Monitor platform performance, availability, and security; respond to incidents and optimize systems 
 Develop and maintain platform tooling, automation, and self-service capabilities 
 Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to improve platform usability and reliability 
 Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards
 Communicate with multidisciplinary SAFe Agile teams and articulate technical concepts and ideas effectively.
 
 Minimum Qualifications :
 Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active TS/SCI with a CI poly clearance (or ability to obtain a CI poly)
 Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 8+ years of experience in platform engineering, systems administration, DevOps, infrastructure, or a related technical field. Equivalent experience will be considered. Additional years of experience commiserate in lieu of a degree.
 Production experience operating Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. 
 Experience supporting production OpenShift environments, including several of the following: cluster lifecycle management, upgrades, Operators, node pools, ingress, registries, and troubleshooting.
 Infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform, scripting, or GitOps.
 Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Argo CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
 Monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity management, and operational runbook development.
 Capable of working effectively with geographically distributed operations and development teams 
 Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with customers and teams in written and oral forums
 Willingness to work 90% or as needed in a SCIF environment with some on-call or after-hours onsite support for customer’s mission
 
 Preferred Qualifications :
 Experience integrating OpenShift with enterprise storage. Familiarity with NetApp ONTAP, Astra Trident, NFS, iSCSI, or CSI-based storage is a plus.
 Security hardening and compliance in restricted, disconnected, or classified environments. 
 Strong scripting or programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) 
 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 
 Understanding of networking, security, and Linux systems administration 
 Experience with hybrid or multi-cloud platform architectures 
 Background in SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) practices
 Experience working with geospatial technology and tools 
 CompTIA Security+ or comparable certification for privileged user access. 
 Experience in/or supporting military/intelligence or knowledge of some IC PED systems is a plus!

 Pay Transparency: In support of pay transparency at Vantor, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings.  The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.
 
 The base pay for this position within California, Colorado, Hawaii, New Jersey, the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and for all other states is:
 
$165,000.00 - $215,000.00 
 Benefits: Vantor offers a competitive total rewards package that goes beyond the standard, including a robust 401(k) with company match, mental health resources, and unique perks like student loan repayment assistance, adoption reimbursement and pet insurance to support all aspects of your life. You can find more information on our benefits at:  https://www.Vantor.com/careers 
 
 The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.  If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. 
 
 The date of posting can be found on Vantor's Career page at the top of each job posting.
 
 To apply, submit your application via Vantor's Career page.
 
 
 EEO Policy: Vantor is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We believe in fostering an environment where all team members feel respected, valued, and encouraged to share their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
